item.title: Can you still file taxes for free after IRS changes?
item.description: A free way to file taxes directly with the IRS has been eliminated, leaving Americans with one fewer way to file in 2026.

item.title: Democratic senator: No end to Iran conflict in sight
item.description: Sen. Mark Warner (D-Va.), the vice chairman of the Senate Intelligence Committee, warned on Sunday that there’s no end in sight to the escalating military conflict with Iran.

item.title: 'Probably' doesn't mean the same thing to your AI as it does to you
item.description: As large language models are increasingly used in high-stakes fields like health care, government policy and scientific reporting, the way they communicate risk becomes a matter of public trust.

item.title: Americans stuck in Middle East speak out amid strikes: 'Beyond scared'
